title: Sync-core record diff mis-patches array elements that change between object and array
reason: The sole comment confirms #10118 changed array/object type transitions to whole-value puts and routed array elements through the same value diff.
assessment: The defect is in tldraw's shared-client/server record patch protocol and its sync-core snapshot deltas. Varve has no live collaboration snapshot-delta protocol; local document persistence serializes canonical documents rather than applying these records.

title: SVG export recomputes every element's full computed style on every call
reason: Reports repeated computed-style extraction for HTML foreignObject content across SVG export calls. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's SVG export builds vector output from scene/render data and does not embed editor HTML foreignObjects through the cited StyleEmbedder loop. This repeated computed-style walk is not a matching local export bottleneck.

title: Edits made in a hidden tab are never synced and are lost when the tab unloads
reason: The comments expand exposure to a non-dotcom low-FPS sync consumer and propose a timer fallback in the SDK scheduler, confirming the core issue is shared collaboration sync rather than only dotcom.
assessment: Varve has no shared sync client that needs to send remote deltas on animation frames. Local durability uses autosave/recovery and backup services with visibility/pagehide lifecycle flush coordination, so the reported network-loss path is absent.

title: Pencil icons appear as if drawn with current pen settings
reason: The sole comment identifies dragging Select, Hand, or Draw toolbar buttons as a likely trigger that paints a stroke-shaped tool icon onto the board; the original report still lacks a recording.
assessment: Varve's tool controls are outside the content canvas event target, so their pointer-down sequence does not enter the canvas tool pipeline. No local stray-pencil report or repro was found; this remains an interaction regression lead for toolbar dragging.

assessment: Varve's scene paint order is explicit and editable through layer ordering. The upstream report lacks enough detail to separate expected stacking behavior from a renderer defect, and does not establish a local reproduction.

title: Pasted SVG markup shows no loading placeholder until the asset finishes loading
reason: The issue distinguishes plain SVG markup on the clipboard from SVG/PNG files and reports blank canvas feedback during a delayed hosted import. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's SVG markup paste action imports markup through the shared file import service and commits artifacts after parsing; the visual feedback during that interval has not been browser-tested. Keep as a local UX parity lead pending a deliberately delayed SVG paste reproduction.

title: Clicks during a camera animation register as drags, causing the Mobile Chrome focus e2e flake
reason: The two comments document frequent mobile failures and note that upstream stops camera animation on a plain left pointer-down, with an alternative fix in #10711.
assessment: Varve animates camera navigation and its canvas pointer-down currently cancels wheel inertia but does not explicitly cancel a camera transition. Its drag threshold is CSS pointer displacement, so the upstream failure mechanism is not identical; a browser test should check text focus and click semantics during a smooth reveal before considering a fix.
